faq.q: How do I start the free trial?
faq.a: Download OZ-POS and launch it — the 90-day trial starts automatically, no signup required.
Yes. Every feature works offline and syncs to the cloud when the connection returns.

faq.q: How do I activate my license key?
faq.a: Open Settings → License, enter your key, and activate. The key binds to your device hardware.

faq.q: Where can I report a bug?
faq.a: Email us at support@oz-pos.com with your version number and a description of what happened.
